# Resources Format Checklist: Unified Catalog Standard (v5.0)

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for the unified resource catalog format (fonts/img/presets) with numeric IDs, sprite-based thumbnails, and legacy-free parsing
**Created**: 2026-09-13
**Feature**: here/specs/001-unified-resource-format/spec.md

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all three catalog scopes (fonts, img, presets) explicitly defined with their respective sprite dimensions? [Spec §FR-001, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the tombstone format for free/available slots explicitly defined as `[id,"","",""]` with no separate free[] list? [Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are error handling requirements defined for all catalog parsing failure modes (non-tuple, invalid ID, missing file)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the write operation behavior defined for both catalog entry creation (high) and deletion (low)? [Spec §FR-001]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the cats field format unambiguous: string for single category, array for multiple? [Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the file extension validation rule documented with a complete list of allowed extensions per scope? [Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the numeric ID derivation from sprite position (id-1) mathematically specified? [Spec §FR-002, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the distinction between Google fonts (no extension) and physical files (with extension) clearly documented? [Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Does the parser requirement (FR-007) consistently apply the ok/free/invalid classification across all three catalog scopes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Are invalid entry handling requirements consistent between gallery display (skip + warn + counter) and render path (reject with cause)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 Do the presets reference requirements (FR-008) align with the catalog ID requirements (FR-002)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-008]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Can the SC-002 outcome (100% entries in unified format) be objectively measured via catalog inspection? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Is SC-003 (100% presets render with correct font on first attempt) measurable through test suite execution? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Does SC-004 (100% items with sprite-generated thumbnails, no 404s) have a clear verification method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are all catalog entry states (ok, free, invalid) covered in parsing requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK016 Are duplicate ID and out-of-range ID scenarios addressed with explicit handling? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the legacy .txm format rejection (with explicit message) defined for pre-migration presets? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Is the behavior for missing physical files defined differently for gallery (skip + warning) vs render (reject with cause)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are duplicate ID conflicts in catalog parsing addressed with resolution guidance? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the empty/missing title or file scenario handled in the classification logic? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK021 Are performance requirements defined for catalog parsing (e.g., no blocking UI during large catalog load)? [NFR, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Is accessibility (keyboard navigation, screen reader) defined for gallery components? [NFR, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the HEAD request requirement for physical file existence validation documented? [NFR, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 Is the dependency on plugin-managed uploads/tm/ storage documented for all three scopes? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the assumption about sprite generation by the client-side ThumbEngine explicitly stated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the required bridge URLs (presetsBase, fuentesBase, imagenesBase) documented for plugin integration? [Dependency, Spec §FR-011]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK027 Is there any conflict between FR-010 (legacy migration) and FR-007 (no legacy support) that requires clarification? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK028 Are the allowed file extension lists complete and unambiguous across all three catalog scopes? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]

## Notes

- Items marked with `[Gap]` indicate requirements that may be missing or incomplete
- Items marked with `[Ambiguity]` indicate requirements that may need clarification
- This checklist validates the **requirements quality** not implementation correctness
